summary: The NRQCD matching material is genuinely new and reuses upstream API well (TauCeti's `Matrix.rank_eq_card_iff_mulVec_injective`, Mathlib's `sum_fiberwise_of_maps_to`, `nhdsGT_le_nhdsNE`); no upstream replacement exists for the one-sided power-sum lemma. However the new general asymptotics lemma leaves an existing in-repo hand-rolled special case standing, and there are two small clones in the diff.
